description:
Add dual-family DataFrame query implementations (expression + pandas) for all 20
FlightData OLAP queries, enabling execution on Polars, PySpark, DataFusion, Pandas,
Modin, cuDF, and Dask platforms.

FlightData is a 3-table benchmark (flights fact table + airlines/airports dimensions)
with 20 queries across 5 categories: on-time performance (5), delay analysis (4),
route analytics (4), temporal patterns (4), and carrier comparisons (3). The queries
use standard OLAP patterns - GROUP BY with aggregations, LEFT JOINs to dimension
tables, CASE expressions, HAVING clauses, date filtering, and ROUND/AVG/SUM/COUNT.

This is one of the simpler benchmarks to port because the schema is small (3 tables),
joins are straightforward (single-key LEFT JOINs to dimension tables), and query
patterns are standard aggregation/filter operations that map cleanly to both
expression-family and pandas-family APIs.

Motivation: FlightData uses real-world aviation data and is popular for OLAP
demos. DataFrame support enables benchmarking DataFrame platforms on realistic
analytics workloads beyond TPC-H/TPC-DS.

work_units.notes:
Create benchbox/core/flightdata/dataframe_queries.py with expression_impl
functions for all 20 queries. Follow the pattern in read_primitives/dataframe_queries.py.

Key translation patterns:
- LEFT JOIN airlines/airports -> ctx.get_table("flights").join(ctx.get_table("airlines"), ...)
- CASE WHEN -> col("x").when(...).then(...).otherwise(...)  (Polars) or F.when() (PySpark)
- ROUND(AVG(...), 2) -> col("x").mean().round(2)
- date filtering -> col("flight_date") >= lit(start_date)
- HAVING COUNT(*) >= N -> filter after group_by
- Integer division for dep_hour -> (col("crs_dep_time") / lit(100)).cast(int)

Queries use parameterized date ranges ({start_date}, {end_date}) - implement
a parameters dict similar to TPCH_DEFAULT_PARAMS in tpch/dataframe_queries.py.

All 20 queries should be implementable; no SQL-only constructs present.
work_units.summary: Create expression-family implementations for all 20 FlightData queries

work_units.notes:
Add pandas_impl functions to each DataFrameQuery in dataframe_queries.py.

Key translation patterns:
- LEFT JOIN -> pd.merge(flights, airlines, left_on="reporting_airline", right_on="code", how="left")
- CASE WHEN -> np.where() or df["col"].apply()
- GROUP BY + agg -> df.groupby([...], as_index=False).agg(...)
- HAVING -> filter after groupby
- ROUND -> .round(2)
- ORDER BY ... LIMIT N -> .sort_values(...).head(N)
- Integer division -> df["crs_dep_time"] // 100
work_units.summary: Create pandas-family implementations for all 20 FlightData queries
